{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df_filtered = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df_filtered['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_count}")

# Drop QA orders
if qa_count > 0:
    df_filtered = df_filtered[~qa_mask]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = df_filtered.groupby('channel')['revenue_numeric'].sum().round(2)

# Find the channel with the highest total revenue
highest_revenue_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
highest_revenue_value = total_revenue_by_channel.max()

# Print results
total_revenue_by_channel, highest_revenue_channel, highest_revenue_value"}
